explanation: The Monaco Grand Prix began in 1929 on the streets of Monte Carlo. The Formula One world championship started in 1950, and Monaco joined its calendar that year.

claims.text: The first Monaco Grand Prix was held in April 1929.

The Monaco Grand Prix was a round of the first Formula One World Championship, in 1950.
